Bug E1: Zombie villager curing does nothing
Files: `pumpkin/src/net/java/play.rs`, `entity/mob/zombie/zombie_villager.rs`
What is wrong: Right-clicking any zombie villager with a golden apple grants the Zombie Doctor advancement immediately. No Weakness check, no timer, no conversion.
